db_evidence.notes: Statement 3 (licorice, chapter 2) and statement 1's disproof (lotus seed actually picked up at 10860s, before the 21420s Chapter-3 title card, i.e. Chapter 2 not Chapter 3) are both fully retrievable from semantic_triples/topic_facts text. Statement 4's disproof (no fire-jujube-seed pickup exists anywhere; the chapter-5-era pickup at ~61950s is 九转金丹, a golden elixir, not a seed) requires either an exhaustive negative text search plus a confirming clip_qa, or a clip_qa directly on the chapter-5 pickup. Statement 2's confirmation (Shuyu Flower seeds, 漱玉花种子, actually obtained inside the 51935-51945s clue window in Chapter 4) is NOT present in any text table (semantic_triples/topic_facts/object_states/entities/visual_clips at that timestamp describe only '灵药 x197 and 金苹果 x1/x3' from a beast kill, missing the seed-pickup HUD notification entirely) - it is visible only in the raw video frame, confirmed by directly extracting frames at 51940-51946s which show an on-screen '漱玉花种子' item-pickup notification. This is a captioning/logging gap in the memory DB, not a retrieval failure by the agent.

root_causes: 3 of 5 rollouts (0, 1, 4) never called clip_qa at all despite exhaustive, repeated empty/irrelevant text search results for 'shuyu flower seed' and 'fire jujube seed' across every table (episodes, semantic_triples, topic_facts, object_states, entities, visual_clips) - they treated absence of contradicting text evidence as confirmation of the question's premise ('all four correct') rather than as a signal that visual verification was required

The two partial-credit rollouts (2, 3) each solved only one of the two errors: rollout 3 correctly used a text-based interval-boundary comparison to catch statement 1 but stopped short of visually checking statement 4; rollout 2 used clip_qa to correctly disprove statement 4 but never revisited or re-verified statement 1, and additionally misidentified an unrelated item (珠树种子, 'pearl-tree seed', at 60570s) as 'Shuyu Flower seeds' rather than visiting the actual 51935-51945s clue window

A genuine DB gap: the Shuyu-Flower-seed pickup notification within the given clue interval (51935-51945s) was never captured by any text-generation layer (episodes/semantic_triples/topic_facts/object_states/entities all describe that window only via combat/loot text, omitting the seed-pickup HUD popup), so any rollout relying purely on text search for statement 2 could not find it - only a targeted clip_qa or frame extraction in that exact window would surface it

This is a Hallucination-Detection question type designed to test whether the agent trusts fabricated premises when memory is silent; three rollouts failed exactly that test by defaulting to 'all consistent' under uncertainty instead of treating an exhaustively empty search as grounds for either a hedged answer or mandatory visual verification
what_worked: Rollout 3's careful boundary check: retrieving the exact chapter-3 title-card timestamp (21420s) and comparing it against the lotus-seed pickup timestamp (10860s) correctly and reliably identified statement 1 as false from text alone
Rollout 2's use of clip_qa on the chapter-5-era pickup (61940-62020s) correctly read the on-screen Chinese text (九转金丹) and correctly concluded it was not a seed, disproving statement 4

All 5 rollouts consistently and correctly retrieved the licorice-seed pickup at 19590-19620s within Chapter 2 (matching clue interval 19617-19627), so statement 3 was never wrongly flagged by any rollout
transferable_lessons: For Hallucination-Detection questions, an exhaustive empty/negative text search result for a named item is itself evidence that the item may not exist as described - it should trigger a mandatory clip_qa/visual check of the referenced time window(s) rather than being read as passive confirmation of the premise

When several statements in a multi-part question must each be checked, verify every statement independently before submitting - do not stop as soon as one contradiction (or one confirmation) has been found; partial verification led directly to the two 2/5 scores here

When a clue interval is given, visit it directly with clip_qa/frame extraction rather than substituting a similarly-named or thematically-similar item found elsewhere via text search (rollout 2 substituted 珠树种子 at 60570s for the actual 漱玉花种子 event at 51940s)

Text captioning of on-screen item-pickup HUD notifications can be incomplete even when combat/loot narration for the same window is present in the DB - for identity/counting/precise-item questions the text layer should not be trusted as exhaustive without a spot-check frame extraction
open_questions: Whether the memory-DB captioning pipeline systematically under-captures brief HUD item-pickup popups relative to combat narration (only one such gap was directly confirmed here, at 51935-51945s) - would need a broader sample to quantify

Whether the general-retrieval skill instructs agents to escalate to clip_qa after N consecutive empty searches; none of the failing rollouts did so despite reading the skill, and rollout 1 even read the visual-verification skill without acting on it
